title: PMAY-U Crosses 1.25 Crore Houses Sanctioned
summary: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) and PMAY-U 2.0 are India’s flagship urban housing schemes under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). On 9 August 2026, the combined sanctioned housing count under these schemes crossed...

blocks.content: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) and PMAY-U 2.0 are India’s flagship urban housing schemes under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). On 9 August 2026, the combined sanctioned housing count under these schemes crossed 1.25 crore, while more than 1 crore houses were completed and handed over to beneficiaries.

items: PMAY-U is the urban component of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.
PMAY-U 2.0 continues the housing mission for urban beneficiaries in India.
CSMC stands for Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee.
Pucca houses are permanent houses built with durable materials such as brick, cement, and concrete.
